app.name: Racio
app.tagline: A clearer view of your money

home.title: Your financial workspace is ready to be built.
home.description: This first screen establishes the language, direction, and modes without inventing financial data.
home.emptyDescription: Your workspace is private and ready for the next product phase. No financial data is stored yet.
home.modeHint: This preference is saved to your account.
home.nextDescription: Sessions, user preferences, and strict user-data isolation

dashboard.title: Your money, this period
dashboard.description: A calm read on position, cash flow, and what needs attention. Every figure keeps its original currency.
dashboard.accountsEmptyBody: Add an account and import a statement to see your financial position.
dashboard.unreviewedBody: Mark them reviewed or fix their details.
dashboard.noTransactionsBody: Import a statement to see cash flow and spending.
dashboard.budgetNeedsAttention: Budget nearing or over its limit

auth.title: Sign in to Racio
auth.description: Use a provider to continue to your private workspace.
auth.noProvider: No sign-in provider is configured for this environment.
auth.callbackError: Sign-in could not be completed. Please try again.
auth.privacy: Racio does not use passwords, magic links, or local session tokens.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Choose how Racio should present your workspace.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.description: Review and revoke active sessions for your account.

accounts.title: Keep your accounts clear
accounts.description: Add the institutions and accounts you use. Racio stores only the details needed to identify them.
accounts.countryHint: Use the two-letter ISO code, such as TR or AE.
accounts.maskedHint: Never enter a full account number or IBAN.
accounts.archiveConfirm: Archive this account? It will be hidden from the active list.
accounts.restoreConfirm: Restore this account to the active list?
accounts.error: The change could not be saved. Check the fields and try again.
accounts.conflictInstitution: An institution with this name already exists.
accounts.conflictAccount: This institution already has an account.
accounts.invalidMasked: Use a masked value, not a full identifier.

imports.title: Bring in a statement carefully
imports.description: Upload one CSV, XLSX, or PDF statement, inspect its source, review uncertain rows, then confirm the final transactions.
imports.chooseFile: Choose CSV, XLSX, or PDF file
imports.retention: Keep the original file after import
imports.retentionHint: Off by default. The original stays private and is deleted after a successful import.
imports.mappingDescription: Racio found a possible layout. Confirm or correct it before parsing the rows.
imports.mappingStillAmbiguous: The worksheet is still ambiguous. Review the row range and required columns, then try again.
imports.reviewDescription: Original values stay visible. Correct only what needs attention, or exclude a row.
imports.confirmDescription: This creates the final transactions atomically. It cannot be undone from this screen.
imports.confirmMismatch: I understand the balance does not reconcile
imports.error: The import could not be completed.
imports.alreadyUploaded: This file was already uploaded for this account. Choose reprocess to create a new review.
imports.workbookSecurityNotice: Racio validates the workbook container, limits, sheets, formulas, links, and embedded content before reading cells.
imports.workbookUnsupportedNotice: Macros, external links, password protection, and executable embedded objects are rejected. Formulas are never calculated.
imports.legacyExcelNotice: Legacy .xls and macro-enabled .xlsm files are not supported. Export a standard .xlsx, CSV, or text-based PDF file from your bank.
imports.pdfSecurityNotice: Racio inspects the PDF container, page limits, and text size before extracting text. Embedded files, actions, and unsafe content are rejected.
imports.pdfScannedNotice: Scanned or image-only PDFs have no usable text and cannot be imported.
imports.pdfLikelyImageOnly: This PDF looks like scanned images without text.
imports.sheetSelectionDescription: This workbook has more than one usable worksheet. Review the bounded samples and choose the single sheet that contains this statement.
imports.workbookWarning: This worksheet needs attention before import.
imports.timeout: Workbook processing took too long. Nothing was imported.
imports.warning_hidden_sheet: This worksheet is hidden and requires an explicit advanced-mode choice.
imports.warning_very_hidden_sheet: This worksheet is very hidden and cannot be imported.
imports.warning_formulas_present: Formula cells are present. Racio never evaluates them.
imports.warning_merged_cells_present: Merged cells may make header mapping ambiguous.
imports.warning_empty_sheet: This worksheet contains no populated cells.
imports.warning_formula_cached_value: A formula-sourced value uses only the cached value stored in the workbook.
imports.warning_formula_value_unavailable: A required formula has no cached value and cannot be imported.
imports.warning_precision_normalized_from_displa: Workbook floating-point noise was normalised using the explicit displayed precision.
imports.warning_invalid_booking_date: The booking date could not be read safely.
imports.warning_invalid_amount: The amount could not be represented safely.
imports.warning_unknown_direction: Debit or credit direction is unresolved.
imports.warning_date_format_not_detected: The statement date format could not be detected.
imports.warning_amount_column_mode_unknown: The amount column layout is ambiguous.
imports.warning_column_headers_present: Column headers were detected and used to map the layout.
imports.warning_possible_summary_row: This row looks like a summary or balance line rather than a transaction.
imports.error_XLSX_UNSUPPORTED_LEGACY_EXCEL: Legacy .xls files are unsupported. Export a standard .xlsx or CSV file.
imports.error_XLSX_MACRO_ENABLED: Macro-enabled workbooks are rejected. Use a standard .xlsx file without macros.
imports.error_XLSX_INVALID_WORKBOOK: This is not a valid standard XLSX workbook.
imports.error_XLSX_INVALID_XML: The workbook contains malformed or unsafe XML.
imports.error_XLSX_PATH_TRAVERSAL: The workbook contains an unsafe internal path and was rejected.
imports.error_XLSX_ARCHIVE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The workbook archive exceeds a safe size, entry, or compression limit.
imports.error_XLSX_EXTERNAL_LINKS_UNSUPPORTED: Workbooks with external links are not supported.
imports.error_XLSX_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT: The workbook contains an unsupported embedded or executable part.
imports.error_XLSX_NO_USABLE_SHEET: The workbook has no usable worksheet.
imports.error_XLSX_SHEET_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The workbook contains too many worksheets.
imports.error_XLSX_ROW_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The selected worksheet contains too many rows.
imports.error_XLSX_COLUMN_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The selected worksheet contains too many columns.
imports.error_XLSX_CELL_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The selected worksheet contains too many populated cells.
imports.error_XLSX_SHARED_STRING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The workbook contains too many shared strings.
imports.error_XLSX_CELL_STRING_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: A workbook cell contains too much text.
imports.error_XLSX_FORMULA_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The workbook contains too many formula cells.
imports.error_XLSX_MERGED_RANGE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The workbook contains too many merged ranges.
imports.error_XLSX_PARSER_TIMEOUT: Workbook processing exceeded the safe time limit. Nothing was imported.
imports.error_XLSX_STALE_SHEET_SELECTION: The worksheet choice is no longer current. Inspect the workbook again.
imports.error_XLSX_INSPECTION_FAILED: The workbook could not be inspected safely. Nothing was imported.
imports.error_XLSX_PARSE_FAILED: The selected worksheet could not be parsed safely. Nothing was imported.
imports.error_PDF_UPLOAD_LIMIT_EXCEEDED: The PDF exceeds a safe upload size.
imports.error_PDF_INVALID: This is not a valid PDF file.
imports.error_PDF_TOO_LARGE: The PDF exceeds a safe size limit.
imports.error_PDF_TOO_MANY_PAGES: The PDF contains too many pages.
imports.error_PDF_CONTENT_LIMIT: The PDF text exceeds a safe processing limit.
imports.error_PDF_NO_USABLE_TEXT: This PDF has no usable text. Scanned or image-only PDFs cannot be imported.
imports.error_PDF_MALFORMED: The PDF is malformed and could not be read.
imports.error_PDF_EMBEDDED_FILE_UNSUPPORTED: The PDF contains an embedded file and was rejected.
imports.error_PDF_UNSAFE_ACTION_OPEN_ATTACHMENT: The PDF requests an action and was rejected.
imports.error_PDF_UNSAFE_ACTION_UNKNOWN: The PDF contains an unsafe action and was rejected.
imports.error_PDF_PARSE_TIMEOUT: PDF processing exceeded the safe time limit. Nothing was imported.
imports.error_PDF_LAYOUT_AMBIGUOUS: The PDF layout is ambiguous and could not be mapped safely.
imports.error_PDF_NO_TRANSACTION_TABLE: No transaction table could be detected in this PDF.
imports.error_PDF_PARSE_FAILED: The PDF could not be parsed safely. Nothing was imported.
imports.error_PDF_INSPECTION_FAILED: The PDF could not be inspected safely. Nothing was imported.

transactions.title: Review your transactions
transactions.description: Edit your descriptions, notes, categories, tags, and review state without changing imported financial facts.
transactions.search: Search description, counterparty, note, category, or tag
transactions.noEvents: No rule history for this transaction.
transactions.error: The transaction could not be updated.
transactions.splitHint: Split amounts must exactly equal the parent amount.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: Keep primary and secondary categories under your control. Imported descriptions remain unchanged.
categories.name: Category name
categories.error: The category could not be saved.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Typed rules run on future imports. Historical application always requires a fresh preview and explicit confirmation.
rules.name: Rule name
rules.confirmHistorical: I confirm this bounded historical application
rules.error: The rule could not be saved.
rules.builderHint: Build a deterministic rule. Imported financial facts are never changed.
rules.stalePreview: The preview is stale or no longer eligible. Preview again.
rules.previewLimited: Preview is limited; historical application is unavailable.
rules.amountCurrencyRequired: Amount conditions require a currency condition.
rules.onePrimary: Use only one primary category action.
rules.actionValueRequired: Choose a category or tag for the action.

merchants.title: Merchants and aliases
merchants.description: Keep merchant names consistent with literal, private aliases. Imported descriptions remain unchanged.
merchants.name: Merchant name
merchants.error: The merchant change could not be saved.

transfers.title: Internal transfers
transfers.description: Review bounded transfer suggestions. Nothing is excluded from reporting until you confirm it.
transfers.error: The transfer change could not be saved.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Set a currency-specific spending limit and compare it with your confirmed spending.
budgets.name: Name
budgets.empty: No budgets yet. Create one to compare planned and actual spending.
budgets.error: The budget could not be saved.

goals.title: Savings goals
goals.description: Set a target and track progress from an explicit amount or a known account balance.
goals.name: Name
goals.empty: No savings goals yet. Create one to track a target.
goals.error: The savings goal could not be saved.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.description: Deterministic warnings about budgets, reconciliation, uncategorized spending, and goals.
alerts.error: The alert change could not be saved.

advisor.title: Ask about your finances
advisor.description: A grounded assistant that answers questions about your own financial data. Every figure comes from Racio's deterministic data services, and nothing is changed without your confirmation.
advisor.askPlaceholder: For example: How much did I spend on groceries this month?
advisor.aiDisabledBody: Racio works fully without it. Enable an AI provider in your server configuration to use the advisor.
advisor.privacyBody: Your question and the verified facts needed to answer it may be sent to the configured AI provider. Only the minimum data required for the question is sent; raw uploaded statements are never sent. The advisor is optional.
advisor.name: Name
advisor.proposalCreated: Preview ready. Nothing changes until you confirm.
advisor.staleProposal: This proposal has expired. Ask again for a fresh preview.
advisor.tamperedProposal: This proposal could not be validated.
advisor.unsupported: I could not understand that question. Try asking about your spending, categories, budget, or goals.
advisor.clarificationMessage: Which period should I look at?
advisor.conversationsEmpty: No conversations yet. Questions you ask are kept here for you to manage.
advisor.disclaimer: AI can make mistakes. Verified amounts come from Racio's data services, and actions require your confirmation.
advisor.noData: There is no data yet for this question. Import a statement to see results.

errors.AI_DISABLED: The AI advisor is disabled on this server.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE: The AI provider is unavailable. Try again later.
errors.AI_PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI provider returned an error.
errors.AI_TIMEOUT: The AI provider took too long to respond. Try again.
errors.AI_RATE_LIMITED: You are asking too quickly. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.AI_INVALID_TOOL_CALL: This question could not be processed.
errors.AI_UNSAFE_PROPOSAL: The proposed action could not be validated.
errors.AI_CONTEXT_LIMIT: Your question is too long. Shorten it and try again.
errors.AI_RESPONSE_INVALID: The AI provider returned an invalid answer. Try again.
errors.INTERNAL: The request could not be completed.

export.title: Export your data
export.description: Download your own transactions or a full archive. Files are generated privately, kept for 24 hours, and never shared.
export.transactionsBody: Export the confirmed ledger with exact amounts. Notes stay out unless you choose to include them.
export.archiveBody: A machine-readable ZIP of your accounts, transactions, categories, tags, merchants, transfers, budgets, goals, alerts, and preferences.
export.includeNotesHint: Notes may contain personal text. They are excluded by default.
export.includeSplitsHint: Adds active split allocations as a separate sheet. Archived split versions are never included.
export.includeAdvisorHint: User-visible conversation text only. Excluded by default.
export.deleteConfirm: Delete this export? The file will be removed.
export.privacyBody: Exports contain your financial data. Generated files are private, expire after 24 hours, and are deleted when you remove them. Keep downloaded files secure.
export.error: The export could not be completed.
export.busy: Another export is still being prepared. Wait for it to finish.
export.tooManyRows: The export exceeds the allowed size.
export.noMatching: No transactions match the current scope.
